# Selection for improved flight performance

## Fecundity

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)
library(nlme)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(patchwork)
library(officer)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Fecund_data_raw" and processed into "Fecund_data"

```{r}
Fecund_data_raw <- read_excel("~/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Raw_data/FF_Fecundity.xlsx", na = "NA")

Fecund_data <- Fecund_data_raw %>% 
  mutate(TotF = PopFemales + Crush_or_Esc_F + Dead_F,
         TotPop = 
           PopMales + PopFemales + 
           Crush_or_Esc_M + Crush_or_Esc_F +
           Crush_or_Esc_U + Dead_M + Dead_F) %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, Replicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(PlateNest = paste(PopRep, Plate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(Ind_Fec = Fecundity/TotF) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "Replicate", "PopRep", "PlateNest"),
            factor)

Mean_fec <- Fecund_data %>% group_by(Selection, PopRep) %>% summarise(M_Fec = mean(Ind_Fec))


```

### Analysis

Fit full model (with 3 replicates per treatment combination)

NOTE: lmer can't fit model with plates nested within population replicates, because there is no replication within plate readings.

```{r}
# -log transform of fecundity, convert plate to factor
Fecund_data <- Fecund_data %>% mutate(log_Fec = -(log(Ind_Fec + 0.00001)), Plate = factor(Plate))

custom_names <- c("Selection", "Selection * Plate")
# AIC
aic_fec <- aictab(cand.set = list(
  lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = FALSE,
                    log_Fec ~ Selection + (1|PopRep)),
  lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = FALSE,
        log_Fec ~ Selection * Plate + (1|PopRep))
), modnames = custom_names)

print(aic_fec)

# AIC results show that the model with only selection has greater weight than the model with selection and plate


# log transformed analysis
fit_Fec_log <- lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = TRUE,
                    log_Fec ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))

a_fit_Fec_log <- anova(fit_Fec_log)
e_fit_Fec_log <- eta_squared(fit_Fec_log)
c_fit_Fec_log <- cohens_f(fit_Fec_log)
e_fit_Fec_log <- left_join(e_fit_Fec_log, c_fit_Fec_log, by = "Parameter")

# fit_Fec_logplate <- lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = TRUE,
#         log_Fec ~ Selection * Plate + (1|PopRep))
# 
# a_fit_Fec_logplate <-anova(fit_Fec_logplate)
# e_fit_Fec_logplate <- eta_squared(fit_Fec_logplate)

# per capita fecundity ANOVA
fit_Fec <- lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = TRUE,
  Ind_Fec ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))

a_fit_Fec <- anova(fit_Fec)
e_fit_Fec <- eta_squared(fit_Fec)

```

## Plots

```{r}
fec_plot <- ggplot(data = Fecund_data, aes(x = Selection, y = Ind_Fec, color = Selection)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = Replicate), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
             size = 3, alpha = 0.5) + 
 stat_summary(fun = "mean", color = "black", shape = "-", size = 4)+
  labs(x = "Selection", y = "Fecundity in 2 hour window (per capita)")

print(fec_plot)
```

#### Additional plots of total fecundity and population size

```{r}
fec_pop <- ggplot(data = Fecund_data) + geom_point(aes(x = PopFemales, y = Fecundity, color = Selection), size = 5, alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = PopFemales, y = Fecundity, shape = factor(Plate)), color = 'black', size = 4) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1", "2", "3")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey', linetype = 'dashed') + theme_cowplot() + guides(shape = 'none') + labs(x = "Population Size (Females)")
                                                            

indfec_plates <- ggplot(data = Fecund_data, 
  aes(x = factor(Plate), y = Ind_Fec)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Selection, shape = Replicate, 
          group = Selection), 
          size = 3, position = position_dodge(width=0.4)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey', linetype = 'dashed') + labs(x = 'Plate', y = "Fecundity in 2 hour window (per capita)") + theme_cowplot()

print(fec_pop)
print(indfec_plates)
```

#### Save tables

```{r}
# AIC model
gt1 <- aic_fec %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(
  'Model formula' = Modnames, K, AICc, Delta_AICc,
  'AICc weight' = AICcWt, LL
) %>% datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "AICc results for models fit for per capita fecundity")

# model with log transformation: ANOVA
gt2 <- a_fit_Fec_log %>% broom::tidy() %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA results, log-transformed per capita fecundity")

# eta-squared partial and cohens_f partial with fecundity log transformation
gt3 <- e_fit_Fec_log  %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Partial Eta-squared value, log-transformed per capita fecundity")

# model without log transformation: ANOVA
gt4 <- a_fit_Fec %>% broom::tidy() %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA results, per capita fecundity")


# correlation of total female population size and total fecundity
# CON correlation
CON_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpop[[1]])) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: CON")
  
# FP correlation
FP_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpop[[2]])) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: FP")

# Save all tables into a single docx
gt_group(gt1, gt2, gt3, gt4, CON_corr, FP_corr) %>% 
  gtsave("../../Tables/fecundity_tables.docx")
```
